frame_row: Document-grounded proposal; no RTL hierarchy is asserted.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_tile_coh_adapter
(m_vlsit_riscv_tile_coh_adapter)
NEW
blocks.function: Terminates one tile's coherent request/response interface; instantiated once for each active hart.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_coh_fabric
(m_vlsit_riscv_coh_fabric)
NEW
blocks.function: New MESI CCU coordinates tagged transactions and two-phase probes; all PREPARE/COMMIT/ABORT ACK waits have no timeout. Culsans supplies architecture reference, not copied RTL.
blocks.source: NEW | VLSIT; Culsans is reference only

label: u_vlsit_riscv_coh_txn_table
(m_vlsit_riscv_coh_txn_table)
NEW
blocks.function: Tracks 2–16 tagged contexts (default 8), line locks and PREPARE/COMMIT/ABORT ACK masks. A missing phase ACK retains its lock and slot until ACK or reset.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_sharer_directory
(m_vlsit_riscv_sharer_directory)
NEW
blocks.function: Independent non-inclusive directory: four banks, eight ways, 4,096/8,192 entries for two/four harts; per-bank round-robin and seven-bit tree-PLRU per set, choosing the lowest-index invalid way first.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_probe_scheduler
(m_vlsit_riscv_probe_scheduler)
NEW
blocks.function: Sends tagged PREPARE/COMMIT/ABORT only to recorded holders and collects one matching response from each target.

label: u_axi_mux
(axi_mux)
REUSE*
blocks.function: Arbitrates compatible AXI request sources into one output while preserving response association.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_device_classifier
(m_vlsit_riscv_device_classifier)
NEW
blocks.function: Classifies normal cacheable memory versus non-cacheable device transactions using the SoC address/attribute contract.

label: u_axi_demux
(axi_demux)
REUSE*
blocks.function: Routes AXI transactions to selected targets with response and ID tracking; configuration must be checked against the chosen topology.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_axi_mmio
(m_vlsit_riscv_axi_mmio)
NEW
blocks.function: Carries non-cacheable peripheral traffic to the external AXI4 device fabric and returns responses without allocating cache lines.

interfaces.name: Tile coherent request service
interfaces.signals: One logical request/response service per active tile; local probe semantics and fields require the pinned Culsans/cache interfaces.

interfaces.name: Tagged transaction context
interfaces.signals: Line address, requester, slot-derived tag, holder/phase masks, dirty-data and LLC status; context is released only after protocol completion.

interfaces.name: Independent sharer directory
interfaces.signals: Four independently arbitrated banks; round-robin grant per bank; 8-way tree-PLRU (0=left, 1=right), lowest-index invalid-way preference, holder bitmap and two-phase victim resolution.

interfaces.name: Tagged two-phase probes
interfaces.signals: PREPARE keeps stable MESI unchanged; COMMIT applies target state; pre-COMMIT ABORT restores the prior state. No ACK timeout in any phase.

interfaces.name: Coherent normal-memory path
interfaces.signals: Cacheable requests, ownership resolution and response data; exact VLSIT record is to be defined from source ports.

interfaces.name: AXI target routing
interfaces.signals: AXI4 transaction channels; route policy is VLSIT-owned.

interfaces.name: Non-coherent AXI4 peripheral
interfaces.signals: AXI4 AW/W/B/AR/R; exact port widths are specified in Section 6.

interfaces.name: Per-tile coherence boundary
interfaces.signals: Replicated logical cache request/response paths; exact RTL pins TBD.

interfaces.name: Shared LLC request boundary
interfaces.signals: AXI4 cache request path; profile-specific external memory service is described separately.

interfaces.name: AXI4 peripheral boundary
interfaces.signals: AXI4 MMIO channels as specified in Section 6.

interfaces.name: Coherence performance taps
interfaces.signals: Candidate hit/miss, probe, conflict and queue events; exact source map is open.

legend_note: The PULP axi_mux/axi_demux blocks are reuse candidates only until the pinned dependency versions and transaction topology are checked. Status codes: REUSE = upstream RTL reused; REUSE* = reuse candidate pending compatibility checks; MODIFY = source adaptation, wrapper, or macro binding; NEW = VLSIT RTL to design; GENERATED = CSR RTL from the selected generator. All proposed blocks are dashed because this cluster has no pinned integrated RTL yet.
